name: Meridian Hatch
description: A radiating sunburst disc, hatch angle drifting and ink color drawn from a small curated set.

code.style: --rule: ( border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient( from @r(0deg, 20deg), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)) 0deg 2.4deg, var(--color0) 2.4deg 7.5deg ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
